selectionRule: The first five entries of Apple's published data/val.txt, in Apple's own file order, excluding 45261179 which was consumed by the one-sample acceptance gate. The order was not sorted, filtered by size, or inspected for room type, and no capture was swapped after any error was seen. The ledger asks for a diverse selection across room types; that diversity cannot be chosen without first looking at the captures, which would break the freeze, so it is not claimed.
heldOutRationale: These are ARKitScenes Validation-split captures. The geometry configuration was frozen against Training scene 47333462, and neither this capture set nor the Validation split contributed to any parameter.
mobileInputSource: ARKitScenes Validation. CA-1M publishes no mobile camera pose; dataset.py fixes the wide sensor RT to the identity.
parameterChangePolicy: No selected scene may drive a geometry threshold change. No geometry parameter was modified for this run.
